name: demo-cyber-denied-bad-network
select: _timestamp, event_action, event_outcome, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS source, source_port, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS destination, destination_port, network_transport, network_bytes, event_original, cisco_asa_rule_name
where: event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed' AND arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', ''), n), ['192.0.2.32/28', '192.0.2.48/28', '192.0.2.64/28', '192.0.2.80/28', '192.0.2.96/28', '192.0.2.112/28', '192.0.2.128/28', '192.0.2.144/28'])
